encoding_notes: Article-type mapping: Brief Review (flagship, novel-hypothesis narrative review) -> narrative_review; Perspectives for Progress (senior-investigator state-of-field/future-directions review, 150 refs, ends in Future Perspectives) -> review; Letters to the Editor-in-Chief -> letter; Invited Commentary -> editorial. Original Research/systematic reviews are NOT accepted (review-only journal). Both review types are proposal/invitation-based.

Main manuscript length is a CHARACTER count, not a word count: ~40,000-46,000 characters including spaces, counting abstract+text+references+tables+figures+legends (~6-8 printed pages). Tightens to 40,000 chars if >4 figures+tables; up to 46,000 if <4. manuscript_max_words left null (no word cap stated) for review/narrative_review.
Figures and tables share a COMBINED cap of 7 total (not 7 each). figures_max/tables_max encoded as 7 as loose upper bounds implied by the combined cap; the real constraint is figures+tables <= 7.

Abstract is 40-60 words (max encoded as 60). Abstract page also requires: a Summary of 15-20 words for the Table of Contents; Key Points of no more than 150 words in 3-5 bullet points; and 5-7 Key Words. Summary and Key Points have no schema slot (highlights_required left null; Key Points is not labeled 'Highlights').
Single-blind peer review: guide states 'Reviewers will know the identity of the author.' No blinding/masking/title-page separation required.

In-text citations use a full-size number on the line in parentheses, e.g. (5, 10) -> in_text 'paren'. References in NLM (Citing Medicine) style, numbered in order of citation. DOI optional/conditional ('may be included' for ahead-of-print/online-only) -> include_doi false. No explicit et al. threshold stated (samples list all authors).
references.max_count left null because the cap is type-dependent (Brief Review ~50 at initial submission; Perspectives up to 150; Letters <=8) — captured per type in word_limits.
Brief Reviews must cite 2-3 of the authors' own peer-reviewed papers (a minimum of the authors' OWN references, not a total minimum) -> references_min left null.

Main figure artwork formats: save as .tiff and .eps; PowerPoint .ppt is also acceptable (not representable in the format enum). Do not compress .tiff. Figure legends listed in the manuscript text file AFTER the references. Minimum DPI/resolution not stated.
Title <=89 characters (no abbreviations); short/running title <=40 characters. Subsection headings: main headings BOLD CAPS <=84 chars; sub-headings Bold Mixed Case <=90 chars.

Additional required non-formatting items with no schema slot: AI-tool-use disclosure; 8-10 continuing-education-credit (CEC) multiple-choice questions; at least one Digital Content Feature (Journal Club / Video Abstract / Visual Abstract); ICMJE-based Copyright Transfer Agreement per author.

line_numbers, font family/size, margins, page size, alignment, first-line indent, page numbers, running-head display, title case, ORCID, and cover letter are all unstated in the guide -> null / conservative false.
Print ISSN 0091-6331 encoded in issn; online ISSN is 1538-3008. Open-access option default license CC BY-NC-ND (not a formatting rule).
